2121402748377891106.en_summary: TheValueist shares key read-throughs from Oscar Health’s $OSCR Q3 2026 earnings call. Results indicate improving economics for well-positioned ACA insurers via ~14% planned premium increases, favorable underwriting, competitor withdrawals and admin leverage, but not uniformly improving healthcare. $250M favorable risk adjustment is company-specific. Positive for Centene marketplace recovery, Allstate supplemental insurance, eHealth employer channel; negative for hospital payer mix (HCA, CYH).
2121402748377891106.zh_summary: TheValueist分享Oscar Health $OSCR 2026年第三季財報電話會議的關鍵解讀。結果顯示定位良好的ACA保險公司透過約14%計劃保費上調、有利承保、競爭對手退出和行政槓桿實現經濟改善，但並非醫療環境普遍改善。2.5億美元有利風險調整為公司特定。對Centene市場復甦、Allstate補充保險、eHealth雇主渠道正面；對醫院支付方組合（HCA、CYH）負面。
